description: Fetch a session artifact (screenshot, report, dump, log, recording) by its swipium://session/<id>/<kind>/<name> URI when the client lacks MCP resources. Text is inline (over 1 MB: the head, or the tail for logs). Binaries return metadata; mode:"inline" returns the bytes (images as JPEG, long edge 1568 px, scale in the text).
name: qa_get_artifact
title: Get an artifact
